# persona register

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:personaRegister`](gmeow-personaRegister.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/personaRegister>
- **Category:** property

A register this persona expresses in — drawn from the names-core [`gmeow:Register`](../classes/gmeow-Register.md) spine (a name register IS a register; persona and address registers share one vocabulary). NOT functional, at least one (SHACL): a persona may span registers (public-formal sliding to public-wry), and the vocabulary is OPEN (sh:nodeKind sh:IRI, never sh:in — [Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use on a [`Persona`](../classes/gmeow-Persona.md) to name the register(s) it expresses in, drawn from the shared names-core [`gmeow:Register`](../classes/gmeow-Register.md) spine.

### Avoid when

- Avoid omitting it (at least one is required — SHACL) and avoid treating the register set as closed — a persona may span registers and the vocabulary is open ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

### How to use

- Point [`gmeow:personaRegister`](gmeow-personaRegister.md) at one or more [`gmeow:Register`](../classes/gmeow-Register.md) individuals; persona and address registers share one open vocabulary.
